There is no f64 Dot3, so the validator is correct\0A//       to reject this module: -Vd does not work around the bug, it just ships\0A//       DXIL no runtime will accept. The defect is that codegen produced it.\0A//\0A//   fxc_10_0_19041 (/T ps_5_0)\0A//       Contrast: FXC compiles the same source without complaint. It does not\0A//       promote the literal-float ternary to double.\0A//\0A// Root cause visible in the -Vd pane: `frac(p) < 0.5 ? 150.0 : 100.0` resolves to\0A// double, so `dot` picks its double overload -- which HLSL has (gen_intrin_main.txt\0A// declares dot over `numeric`) but DXIL cannot express.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0Afloat4 ps_main(float3 p : POS) : SV_Target0\0A{\0A#if 0\0A\09// Works\0A\09float3 t = frac( p ) < 0.5 ? 150.0 : 100.0;\0A\09float3 r = dot(t, 1).xxx;\0A#endif\0A\0A#if 1\0A\09// Validation error\0A\09float3 r = dot(frac( p ) < 0.5 ? 150.0 : 100.0, 1).xxx;\0A#endif\0A\0A\0A\09return float4(r, 1.0f);\0A}\0A"}
